title: S01 City Bicycle
description: Original static city bicycle with two open annular tires, restrained rims and spokes, diamond frame, twin fork and rear stays, saddle, handlebar, separate static chainring/sprocket/closed chain outline, pedals and a deployed ground stand. Current fixed tire/frame clearance is checked against real meshes. Independent editable static source and GLB components with baked static transforms. No wheel rotation, steering, drivetrain, chain-link or physics simulation. The tested centered placement in the legacy three-hoop rack is incompatible; no rack compatibility claim.
